interpretation_limits: Retain every accepted plane at every iteration, every class residual and all extracted source/target point clusters for all selected cases. Use offline GT relative transform only for static-consistency residuals and geometry, never feed GT to continuous reference. Sum class and cluster first-system gradients through the same total damped Hessian (conditional contribution, not independent nonlinear cause). Group IDs are per frame, not tracked semantic objects. Disagreement can include visibility, calibration, segmentation and wrong associations, not proof of a moving car.
